answer.reason: I diagonalized the full d3 Hamiltonian (Coulomb repulsion with B = 828 cm⁻¹ and C = 3390 cm⁻¹, plus the octahedral field) in a Slater-determinant basis and labelled each level by its spin and symmetry. At Dq/B = 0 the levels are degenerate, so the order of tied levels there is arbitrary.
